description: This Java source file defines the factory class `AcknowledgementFactory` which provides static methods to create and manipulate acknowledgement-related objects such as `Acknowledgement` and `Acknowledgements`. It acts as an entry point for creating instances around end-to-end acknowledgements, including building new acknowledgements, combining multiple acknowledgements, and creating empty acknowledgements for specific entities.

classes.name: AcknowledgementFactory
classes.description: A final utility class providing static factory methods to create and combine acknowledgement objects in the system.

methods.name: newAcknowledgement
methods.description: Creates a new `Acknowledgement` instance with specified label, entity ID, status code, headers, and optional payload.

methods.name: newAcknowledgements
methods.description: Creates a new `Acknowledgements` instance by combining a collection of acknowledged objects with specified headers.

methods.name: newAcknowledgements (overload)
methods.description: Creates a new `Acknowledgements` instance from an entity ID, a collection of acknowledgements, status code, and headers, typically used for deserialization.

methods.name: emptyAcknowledgements
methods.description: Creates an empty `Acknowledgements` instance for a specific entity ID and headers.
